_help: Places that are not on the CDU PDF map or in OpenStreetMap, such as the bookshop or named cafes.
Add one entry per place, then run: python campus_data/scripts/build_places.py
category: one of toilets, food, library, venue, gallery, services, info, atm, post, security, parents, bus, taxi, parking, outdoor, bookshop
building: the building label as on the map (e.g. 'Red 1'); the place is shown at that building.
Instead of building you can give an exact position as lonlat: [130.8690, -12.3720].
